purpose: Wellbeing-indexed governance token reflecting human development, ethical authority, trauma-prevention, and system balance.

humanDevelopmentIndex.description: Measures contributor growth, wellbeing, stability, and skill development.

systemBalanceIndex.description: Tracks harmony between modules, workflows, and governance kernels.

ethicalAuthorityScore.description: Evaluates transparency, non-coercive operations, and ethical alignment.

harmPreventionScore.description: Monitors harm detection, prevention, escalation control, and support pathways.

governanceIntegrityScore.description: Ensures chain-of-custody, validator enforcement, and federal-record alignment.
